hook.text: That waxy shine on apples? It's shellac or carnauba wax—an edible coating that slows moisture loss and browning.

buildup.text: Edible coatings create a semi-permeable barrier on food surfaces, controlling gas exchange and moisture evaporation.

discovery.text: Apeel Sciences created a plant-based coating that doubles avocado shelf life. It's made from discarded fruit peels.

twist.text: Chitosan coatings—derived from shrimp shells—have antimicrobial properties. Shellfish waste becomes food preservation technology.

climax.text: Edible coatings could reduce plastic packaging need by 40% for fresh produce. Less plastic, longer freshness.

punchline.text: Coat the food, skip the plastic. Nature-based barriers are the future.

quiz.question: How does Apeel's plant-based coating work?
options: It creates a barrier that slows moisture loss and oxidation
